questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to ANCIENT.
questions.e: Ancient means very old; modern is its opposite. The other three are near-synonyms.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to BRAVE.
questions.e: Brave means courageous; cowardly means lacking courage.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to INCREASE.
questions.e: To increase is to become greater; to decrease is to become less.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to VICTORY.
questions.e: Victory means winning; defeat means losing.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to SCARCE.
questions.e: Scarce means in short supply; plentiful means available in large amounts.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to TRANSPARENT.
questions.e: Transparent lets light pass through; opaque does not.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to HOSTILE.
questions.e: Hostile means unfriendly or antagonistic; friendly is the opposite.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to DILIGENT.
questions.e: Diligent means hardworking; indolent means lazy.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to LOQUACIOUS.
questions.e: Loquacious means very talkative; taciturn means habitually silent. The other three are synonyms of loquacious.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to EPHEMERAL.
questions.e: Ephemeral means lasting a very short time; eternal means lasting forever.
